item.title: MDLR JAM 03 - Live 5U Modular Session
item.description: video upload by rimela "A live-recorded modular improvisation shaped around a bleak, dystopian atmosphere. Phaser-washed Polysix pads set the mood. Clock and triggers come from the Roland TR-505, driving the system in sync. Captured in one take – no edits, no overdubs – just the patch unfolding in real time."

item.title: Roland MKS-80 :: Warm Pads
item.description: video upload by Harry van Mierloo "The Roland MKS-80 isn't known as a typical analog pad machine like the JX-8P or the MKS-70, but still its VCOs are capable of creating some wonderful pads. I couldn't find many pad demos of the MKS-80 online, because most demos contain the powerful analog sounds that the Jupiter-series is so famous for. So I decided to record a few soft pads chords on the MKS-80
